_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Root opens the pinned Assistant; explicit conversation links remain selected. The server runs in workspace mode, with the conversation {{CONV_ID}} (slug {{CONV_SLUG}}), and the onboarding card not dismissed. Call "archive a new task" starts another conversation, {{ARCHIVED}}, and archives it. "The row of" a conversation X is ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id=\"X\"]". On a fresh server the first load of a page takes a few seconds while the Assistant is created (the header title reads "Shelley" until then): wait for elements rather than reading the page right after navigating. On a phone-sized screen the drawer is off-canvas until the header's "Open tasks" button is clicked. To "open the drawer": click the button named exactly "Open tasks" if it is visible (on a phone it is whenever the drawer is closed: it is the header's top-left button; the drawer's own "Close tasks" button stays in the page while the drawer is off-canvas, so it says nothing about whether the drawer is open); the element with data-testid "assistant-row" should then be visible within the viewport. To "reload": the reload action. To "open the settings of" a project P: click "section[aria-label=\"P\"] a.project-select", then, in the element with data-testid "project-view", click the button named exactly "Settings" in its navigation (its <nav> element; click it even when its tab already shows); "the editor" is the region (role "region"; a <section> with that aria-label) named exactly "Edit project". To "edit project P" with a change: eval sessionStorage.setItem("editFrom", location.pathname) to remember the page; open the drawer; open the settings of P; make the change in the editor; click the editor's button named exactly "Save project"; the editor's text "Saved." should be visible; then return to the remembered page with a full load: eval (() => { window.__leaving = 1; location.assign(sessionStorage.getItem("editFrom")); return "leaving"; })(), expecting "leaving", then eval "window.__leaving === undefined && document.readyState === 'complete'" until it returns true. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /. 2. "h1.header-title" should have exactly the text "Assistant". 3. The page title should start with "Assistant - ". 4. The heading named exactly "What would you like to get done?" should be visible. 5. There must be exactly 1 element with data-testid "onboarding-web-app" (the onboarding card offers ways to start until the user dismisses it). 6. Open the drawer. 7. There must be exactly 1 element with data-testid "assistant-row", and exactly 0 matching ".conversation-group [data-testid=\"assistant-row\"]". 8. There must be exactly 0 elements with data-testid "nav-tab-prod" (the dev/prod tabs need their own flag). 9. There must be exactly 0 buttons named exactly "View Archived" (archived tasks are behind search's Archived toggle; the footer button is stock Shelley's). 10. Call "archive a new task". 11. The row of {{CONV_ID}} should be visible. 12. There should be exactly 0 rows of {{ARCHIVED}}. 13. Click the button named exactly "Search tasks...". 14. Click the element with data-testid "archived-toggle" ("the toggle"). 15. The toggle should have aria-pressed "true". 16. The row of {{CONV_ID}} should be visible. 17. The row of {{ARCHIVED}} should have the class "conversation-item-archived". 18. The assistant row should be visible, with exactly 0 buttons inside it. 19. The button named "Restore" in the row of {{ARCHIVED}} must be hidden (an archived row's Restore and Delete take its Archive's place). 20. Click the row of {{ARCHIVED}}. 21. Open the drawer. 22. The button named "Delete" in the row of {{ARCHIVED}} should be visible (a touch screen shows them on the open row). 23. Click the button named "Restore" in the row of {{ARCHIVED}}. 24. The row of {{ARCHIVED}} should come to not have the class "conversation-item-archived". 25. Click the toggle. 26. The row of {{ARCHIVED}} should be visible. 27. Navigate to /c/{{CONV_ID}}. 28. "h1.header-title" should come to not have exactly the text "Assistant". 29. The URL should end with /c/{{CONV_SLUG}} or /c/{{CONV_ID}}, with nothing after it.
